english.note: Use this for the non-alcoholic fruit drink sense, especially when the context makes clear that concentrate has been diluted with water.

examples.english: This squash needs to be diluted with water before it tastes good.
examples.traditional: 呢樽果汁飲品要加水開先好飲。
